subject: Premier demo — exec slot request and calendar options
messages:
From: Lydia Park <lpark@greenfield.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Premier demo — request for VP/CIO exec slot

Hi Markus,

Thanks for the quick intro on Friday. Greenfield Financial is ramping an evaluation of inference platforms and wed like to schedule a focused demo next week. High level: engineering wants the deep technical runthrough, but leadership (VP of Eng + CIO) need a short exec session to cover integration risk, security posture, and high-level TCO.

Could we do a 60‑minute technical demo with a 25–30 minute exec Q&A portion reserved for our VP of Engineering (Lydia Park) and CIO (Michael Cho)? Ideal outcomes: 1) leadership gets direct answers on data locality & audit logs, 2) engineering sees latency/throughput numbers on our workload, 3) we have clear next steps for procurement.

Windows were hoping for (PT):
- Tue Nov 17: 10:00–11:00 or 15:00–16:00
- Thu Nov 19: 13:00–14:00
I can be flexible on Thursday if that makes executive attendance easier.

Attached a short agenda for the session (premier-demo-agenda.pdf). Also happy to share a short list of exec questions in advance if that helps shape the 30‑minute slot.

Best,
Lydia Park
Director, Platform Strategy
Greenfield Financial
Attachments: premier-demo-agenda.pdf (pdf)

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
To: Lydia Park <lpark@greenfield.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 13:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Premier demo — request for VP/CIO exec slot

Hi Lydia — thanks, this is helpful.

Wed be glad to run that format. Quick notes from our side: Ben (AE) will lead the commercial framing, Rachel (CS) will cover onboarding/SLAs, and Ill drive the technical demo. For the exec segment we recommend reserving the final 30 minutes for Michael and your VP — that tends to keep the session focused.

Proposed slots (PT):
- Tue Nov 17, 15:00–16:00 (exec segment 15:30–16:00)
- Thu Nov 19, 13:00–14:00 (exec segment 13:30–14:00)
- Fri Nov 20, 09:00–10:00 (exec segment 09:30–10:00)

If Michael prefers a separate 30‑minute sync outside the demo, we can do that as well. Please confirm the preferred slot and the exact exec attendee names/titles so we can include the right folks and prepare a short, executive-friendly slide deck.

Im attaching our demo pack (redwood-demo-pack.pdf) — it has a short security appendix and a latency/throughput example that may be useful for Michael.

If it helps, Ben can draft a mutual action plan with procurement milestones after we lock a time.

— Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood-demo-pack.pdf (pdf)

From: Lydia Park <lpark@greenfield.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Michael Cho <mcho@greenfield.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Premier demo — request for VP/CIO exec slot

Markus — thanks, that lineup looks great.

Were locking Thu Nov 19, 13:00–14:00 PT with the exec segment from 13:30–14:00. Michael Cho (CIO) will join the exec portion, and Ill stay for the full demo. Attendee list:
- Lydia Park — VP, Platform Strategy (full session)
- Michael Cho — CIO (exec 13:30–14:00)
- Engineering participants TBD (I will send names by EOD Wed)

Ive attached the calendar invite (greenfield-redwood-demo.ics) and added a few top-of-mind exec questions in the event description (data residency, audit trail retention, SLA credits). We also uploaded a short procurement checklist to the Drive link in the metadata.

If you want to run a 5–10 minute dry run for the technical demo content, Ben and I are available Wed Nov 18 morning. Otherwise well see you Thursday.

Regards,
Lydia Park
Director, Platform Strategy
Greenfield Financial
Attachments: greenfield-redwood-demo.ics
